surface: POST lifecycleUrl with {orderId, providerTaskId, action, request, authorization, grant, payer, gatewayAudience}; answer {orderId, taskId, state, operations, signature} plus result (artifact, support), terminalAttestation (completed, failed, canceled) and inputRequest/documents only when the daski-order-status-view header asks
signature: signature: EIP-191 by the provider authority key over keccak256(canonicalJson(answer without signature)), terminalAttestation included; terminalAttestation.signature: EIP-191 by the terminal attestation key over keccak256(canonicalJson(payload)), payload {orderId, taskId, state, resultHash, completedAt}

authorization.readCapability: authorization is {type: "DaskiReadCap", scope: action}, for status and artifact only; the grant's authorizationHash is canonicalHash of it
authorization.payerSigned: authorization is the buyer's OrderActionAuthorizationV1 (nine fields); its EIP-712 signature recovers to the order's payer for domain {name: DaskiStandardOrder, version: 1, chainId} with audienceHash keccak256(gatewayAudience); the grant's authorizationHash is canonicalHash of the whole authorization
authorization.grant: ProviderLifecycleGrantV1 signed by gateway-lifecycle for the provider audience, valid at most 120 seconds, payload {orderId, providerTaskId, action, requestHash, authorizationHash, payer}

verdicts.accepted: The gateway passes the signed answer to the buyer; the order moves to orderStateAfter.
verdicts.refused: The gateway names the refusal to the buyer with code and status.
verdicts.rejected: The gateway refuses the answer; the buyer sees an internal error and the provider's text is never shown.
